Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy

The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.5754 Of 2020
Order:

-
This petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, is filed seeking return of the property that was seized in Crime No.185 of 2020 of Macharla Town Police Station, Guntur District.

entities.text: Macharla Town Police Station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
3. A case in Crime No.185 of 2020 was registered against the petitioners herein by Macherla Town Police for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 328, 270, 273 IPC and under Sections 56,
57(1) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act.
Incidentally, police have seized Ashok Leyland mini transport vehicle bearing registration No.AP 39 TG 8351 and the tobacco products during the course of investigation in the above crime.
4. The petitioners sought quash of the said F.I.R registered against them in Criminal Petition No.5555 of 2020 before this Court.
This Court, by its common order dated 03.12.2020, quashed the said F.I.R registered against the petitioners.
Therefore, the petitioners are entitled for return of the said vehicle and the tobacco products that were seized from their possession in the above crime.

5. In the result, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the Station House Officer of Macherla Town Police Station, Guntur District, is hereby directed to return the said Ashok Leyland mini transport vehicle bearing registration No.AP 39 TG 8351 and the tobacco products seized from the possession of the petitioners in the above crime on proper identification and acknowledgment.
